form.label: Imperva IOC Block – blocked IPs / Unblock
form.description: IPs on the WAF policy, read live from Imperva (auto refresh 5 min and after every unblock). Click rows to select, fill Ticket / Incident no. and Description, then click 🔓 UNBLOCK. An unblocked IP disappears from the table.

search.query: | impervalist | eval _refresh=$b_refresh|s$ | lookup imperva_block_registry site_id ip OUTPUT status AS reg_status blocked_at blocked_by incident_no comment source | append [| inputlookup imperva_block_registry where status="blocked" | eval in_waf="no" | rename status AS reg_status | fields site_id ip in_waf reg_status blocked_at blocked_by incident_no comment source] | stats max(in_waf) AS in_waf values(site_name) AS site_name values(reg_status) AS reg_status max(blocked_at) AS blocked_at values(blocked_by) AS blocked_by values(incident_no) AS incident_no values(comment) AS comment values(source) AS source values(detail) AS detail max(checked_at) AS checked_at BY site_id ip | eventstats max(eval(if(in_waf="error",1,0))) AS site_err max(checked_at) AS last_check BY site_id | where (ip!="-" AND in_waf!="empty") OR in_waf="error" | eval verification=case(in_waf="error", "⚠ Cannot read WAF: ".mvjoin(detail," "), in_waf="yes" AND reg_status="blocked", "✔ Verified on WAF", in_waf="yes", "✔ On WAF (blocked outside Splunk)", site_err=1, "⚠ Unknown (WAF read error)", true(), "✖ NOT on WAF - removed outside Splunk") | eval blocked_time=if(isnotnull(blocked_at), strftime(blocked_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "-") | eval last_checked_on_waf=strftime(last_check, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval ticket=coalesce(mvjoin(incident_no, ", "), "-"), description=coalesce(mvjoin(comment, "; "), "-"), blocked_by=coalesce(mvjoin(blocked_by, ", "), "-") | sort 0 - blocked_at

single.title: Blocked on WAF now

search.query: | where in_waf="yes" | stats dc(ip) AS total

single.option: read live from the WAF policy

single.title: Registered as blocked but NOT on WAF
single.option: select them and Unblock to close

search.query: | stats max(last_check) AS t | eval t=strftime(t, "%H:%M:%S")

input.label: 🔎 Search IP / Ticket / Incident no. / Description (* = all)

search.query: | makeresults | eval ips=trim($b_sel|s$, ","), n=if(ips="", 0, mvcount(split(ips, ","))) | eval Action=if(n=0, "Click rows below to select IPs", "🔓 UNBLOCK ".n." IP".if(n=1, "", "s")), Clear=if(n=0, "-", "✖ Clear selection") | eval selected_ips=if(n=0, "-", replace(ips, ",", ", ")), ticket=$b_tk|s$, description=$b_desc|s$ | table Action Clear selected_ips ticket description

panel.title: Unblock result – written to the audit log (click a row to close)

search.query: | makeresults | eval _run=$b_exec_id|s$ | impervablock action=unblock ip=$b_exec_ips|s$ incident_no=$b_exec_tk|s$ description=$b_exec_desc|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status verified ticket description backend soar_container detail

panel.title: IPs blocked on the WAF policy (read live) – click a row to select / unselect it

search.query: | eval _q=lower(trim(replace($b_q|s$, "[*]", ""))) | where _q="" OR like(lower(ip." ".ticket." ".description." ".blocked_by), "%"._q."%") | eval Events="🔍 Search" | table blocked_time ip ticket description blocked_by verification site_id site_name last_checked_on_waf Events
